# Family WikiTree Plugin

> WikiTree → nFamily migration helper (PLANNED). **Free — MIT licensed.**

## Install

```bash
nself plugin install family-wikitree
```

No license key required.

## Description

WikiTree → nFamily migration helper (PLANNED). WikiTree is a free public genealogy wiki with a REST API (Apps API).

Category: `social`. Current version: `1.1.2`.

## Configuration

| Env Var | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | `(required)` | PostgreSQL connection string |

## Ports

| Port | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| 3512 | Family WikiTree service port |

## Examples

```bash
nself plugin install family-wikitree
```
